messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected: ~20% error rate for eu-west -> us-east steering path. Sampling indicates 502/504 + elevated p95. Impacting ~12% of eu-west origin traffic. Playbook: routing/steer-fallback. Link: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/routing/steer-fallback

sarah_oncall: ack. paging @mike_neteng and @raj_sre. I'm taking initial triage. grabbing dashboards and recent deploys. :rotating_light:

mike_neteng: looking at control-plane. There's a routing policy rollout `policy-rl-2026-04-12-59` that finished ~4m ago. The weight table from eu-west now shows ~85% -> us-east, 15% -> eu-west local. expected is ~95% local. suspect mis-ship. pulling current config: 

```json
{"policy_id":"policy-rl-2026-04-12-59","rules":[{"from":"eu-west","weights":[{"to":"us-east","weight":0.85},{"to":"eu-west","weight":0.15}]}]}
```

raj_sre: can you also check if any DNS pins persisted at edge? if steering dropped then some clients may still have stale pins because of TTL anomalies. also verify health-checks on us-east egress (weird 502s could be backend overload there).

deploy-bot: deployment complete: routing-api/steer-manager @ sha=abcdef123 (policy rollout id: policy-rl-2026-04-12-59). started 1725004000 finished 1725004200.

emily_support: CS reports multiple customers seeing 502 spikes. AcmeCorp SE says ~30% of their calls failing in eu-west region. Opening priority support ticket and notifying account execs.

mike_neteng: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback to previous stable policy `policy-rl-2026-04-11-77` OR 2) apply an override to set eu-west -> us-east weight to 0 (force local). rollback is heavier; override is quick and reversible. recommend override now. need approval to apply.

sarah_oncall: approved to apply override. do it.

sarah_oncall: applying override now:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://routing.internal/api/v1/policies/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTING_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\n    "policy_id":"policy-rl-2026-04-12-59",\n    "overrides":[{"from":"eu-west","to":"us-east","weight":0}]\n  }'
```

sarah_oncall: response: 200 OK. override id OV-1725004321. Applying telemetry watch. :eyes:

ops-bot: audit: override OV-1725004321 applied by sarah_oncall at 1725004380. Change propagated to steer edge within 18s. Telemetry hook: 5xx rate (eu-west->ingress) dropped 20% -> 3% over ~90s. p95 latency improved ~350ms -> 120ms.

mike_neteng: good. need to purge edge DNS/steer cache in eu-west to avoid any pinned clients continuing to point to us-east: running dns-purge script now.

```bash
# on ops-host
/usr/local/bin/dns-purge --region eu-west --cache steer-cache --force
```

/usr/local/bin/dns-purge: purged 12 nodes, invalidated 183 keys, exit 0

raj_sre: running synthetic checks from eu-west vantage points (3 probes).

```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://api.redwood.example/health -H "Host: api.redwood.example"
# probe results:
200 0.18s
200 0.20s
200 0.19s
```

emily_support: drafting proactive customer message (will post after you confirm mitigation stable for 15m):

"We observed a routing configuration issue impacting requests from EU-West to US-East which caused elevated error rates. We've applied an emergency override to route traffic locally and the service has recovered. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a full postmortem."

sarah_oncall: mitigation looks to be effective. 5xx back to baseline. will monitor for 30m. handing off to nina_oncall for next-shift watch. summary for handoff: 
- root cause (suspected): bad rollout config changed steering weights (policy-rl-2026-04-12-59)
- mitigation: override OV-1725004321 applied (set eu-west->us-east weight=0), edge DNS purge, synthetic validation
- impact: ~12% of eu-west requests, some customers saw 502 spikes (AcmeCorp hit ~30% of calls)
- next steps: full rollback of the bad rollout OR patch rollout to correct weights, postmortem + deployment guardrails

nina_oncall: ack. taking watch. I'll keep an eye on error-rate, p95, and customer tickets. starting 30m timer. who owns the postmortem?

product-support: we'll own the postmortem and coordinate with neteng and deploy teams. will create doc and invite relevant folks.

sarah_oncall: thanks all. logging timeline to incident system and updating ticket. marking mitigation in status page draft. handing off Slack thread. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident state updated: PAGE_ACK -> MITIGATED. Channel will remain open for 60m for follow-up. Postmortem owner: product-support.

nina_oncall: quick note for follow-up: 1) add a deployment-time sanity check to steering-manager CI to assert expected weight ratios for region-only rollouts; 2) add an alert for weight deviation >10% from expected for 5m; 3) confirm TTLs at edge are not being ignored by steer-manager cache invalidation.

sarah_oncall: yep adding those to action list. will include owners in postmortem doc.

product-support: created PM doc: https://workdocs/internal/postmortems/PM-1725004321 (draft). invited @mike_neteng, @raj_sre, @sarah_oncall, @deploy-bot.

incident-bot: thread closed for active paging. last_message_ts 1725006100.
